%c[0,224,224,224]An insulin pump is a medical device used for the administration of insulin in the treatment of diabetes mellitus, also known as continuous subcutaneous insulin therapy. The device configuration may vary depending on design. 
 
%c[0,162,162,162]Standard quality device for a civilian market, maybe a bit dirty here and there.

%c[0,224,224,224]An insulin pump is a medical device used for the administration of insulin in the treatment of diabetes mellitus, further modified by Zone's survivalists, potentially initially designed by either Ecologists or Clear Sky to support their expeditionary troops on long treks through the Zone. Its main purpose is to help a wounded stalker survive situations ranging from open wounds after a gunfight to taking in too much radiation after artifact hunting. Nicknamed "Feniks" or Phoenix due to the device's restorative properties and its ability to save one from the death's door.
 
 %c[0,96,211,75]A masterwork device designed by the most skilled craftsmen and filled with the best restorative mixtures of medicine known to Zone.

%c[0,224,224,224]This Electromagnetic dispersion device is made out of an EMF Meter with several modes for checking different interferences in the air in mind. It was further modified to capture electric discharges aimed at the holder as well as a tiny amount of radioactive particles and disperse them around the user, protecting their body from most of the harm. For a device of this scale, its sadly impossible to stop an entire discharge of most anomalies found in the Zone, although it will lessen the blow.
 
%c[0,162,162,162]A civilian-grade device used to measure AC/DC electromagnetic fields generated by man-made electrical wiring, further modified to apply protection from the very same sources.

%c[0,224,224,224]ExEIN-26 - External Environmental Influence Nullifier mod.26 is a modified and modernized Electromagnetic Dispersion Device. Most often found on UNISG commandos sent into the Zone on dangerous missions in anomalous areas. Extremely valued for their effectiveness in highly irradiated and electrically charged areas, while being effective against thermal and chemical environments to a certain degree. This device is able to absorb a much higher amount of harmful effects from radiation and electric discharges to covert their energy into cooling the body, hence giving the user the much needed thermal protection.

 
%c[0,96,211,75]A masterwork device made in a lab, tested on various exported artifacts and anomalies created in controlled environment. Can't get better than this with such a small, portable size.

%c[0,224,224,224]Psiokinetic Active Defense System or PADS is a device constructed from all sorts of electronic devices commonly found in the Zone to construct an application device to condense the psiokinetic ability of a Burer or a Poltergeist into a dampening field around the wearer, to lessen the speed of incoming projectiles, lessening their harmful effect on the user.
 
%c[0,162,162,162]Its makeshift quality is visible in the old gauges, rusty metal and exposed wires. The rusty metal seems to be leaking radiation that's emitted during synthesizing of the protective shield.

%c[0,224,224,224]Psiokinetic Active Defense System or PADS is a device constructed from all sorts of electronic devices commonly found in the Zone to construct an application device to condense the psiokinetic ability of a Burer or a Poltergeist into a dampening field around the wearer, to lessen the speed of incoming projectiles, lessening their harmful effect on the user.
 Further improved by replacing old scrap with properly cleaned and insulated platings, properly protected wiring and better psionic condensors to enhance the protective effects of the device.
 
%c[0,96,211,75]Much better quality than its original variant, able to protect the user without a risk of being electrocuted by an exposed wire or the residual heat being released towards the wearer's body.

%c[0,224,224,224]A compact device cobbled together from an old neurodiagnostic unit, military electronics and a few components of various detectors and anomalous measurement devices. Its purpose is to interfere with anomalous wavelengths that affect the human brain, reducing their intensity before they can fry the operator's grey matter.
Zone's scientists who have been subjected to effects of psi anomalies in controlled environments have expressed that such a device can be combined with the already existing psi-helmets to further enhance survivability in areas where one's brain and sanity is at risk.
 
%c[0,162,162,162]Device meant to supplement psi-helmet, but absolutely not meant to replace it. It will not make the user immune to a psi-emitter, but it will give them enough time to run away.

%c[0,224,224,224]A heavily modified External Brain-Wavelength Dampener, tweaked and tuned to make its output respond better to the psi-electromagnetic frequencies found in the Zone. When activated, it produces a localized protective field capable of dampening the influence of certain anomalous wavelengths emitted by both anomalies and mutants alike. Due to it's increased strength, it needed a bigger, anomalous battery, hence becoming bulky and hot really fast.
 
%c[0,96,211,75]Top notch device meant for the most dangerous of places, where one's mentality is at risk.
